machines.recoveryBoundary: Private updater candidate store; restart re-verifies staged bytes and signed metadata.
Root and user receipts, installation enrollment, launchd observation, fixed artifact verification, and explicit repair-required output.
Root-owned network recovery journal plus fresh Core, utun, route, DNS, socket, peer, and installation-key observation.

The admitted Profile ID/revision/fingerprint, committed runtime authority ID, exact prior runtime instance, Capture operation/selection, candidate home, and Capture journal are re-observed before commit or compensation; ambiguity becomes RecoveryRequired.

The existing Capture journal and exact prior System Proxy/TUN state remain authoritative; restart and every terminal apply restore are decided from fresh platform observation and explicit drift/recovery-required evidence.

A minimal Kotlin-owned foreground-service recovery record plus fresh VPN permission, foreground, TUN, route, DNS, Core, protected-socket, public-request, and validated-network facts; invalid, ambiguous, or prior-process evidence becomes safely stopped or recovery-required under the new Rust authority.

Process-local Profile/runtime/capture/Controller-session identity plus a complete fresh Controller baseline; rows and presentation remain outside the machine, and gaps require another complete baseline before command authority returns.
Managed runtime identity, process ownership, candidate home, controller readiness, and stop/rollback confirmation.

Versioned bounded RecoveryRecord plus the private partial/candidate store, immutable release identity, resume validators, signed metadata high-water marks, and mandatory candidate re-verification after restart.
Versioned operation-owned private maintenance journal reconciled before every automatic Profile, Core, or Capture launch; unknown outcomes are never replayed.
Settings revision, atomic settings record, bounded backup manifest, and exact restore validation.
One graceful-exit owner, aggregate cleanup report, runtime retirement, and native projection teardown.
Process-local run ID and runtime identity; no durable resume, but cancellation and finalization are required.
Connection-local epoch/subscription identity and authoritative reconnect baseline; this is a TypeScript transport state machine, not a Rust internal lifecycle.
Simple bounded one-shot observation has no mutation or multi-step recovery; transactional adapters must be separately classified before adding orchestration.
Hover, disclosure, filter, animation, and reversible local presentation state are discarded on remount and never publish product authority.
